_comment: Committed deterministic test embedding fixture (E1 / G11 / PLAN Q7). acorn STORES + SEARCHES vectors; embedding GENERATION is app code, NOT acorn's (TOOL-MATRIX §7). Committing a fixed vector keeps the pgvector golden task (G11) deterministic + free + secret-less — no live OPENAI_API_KEY. 1536-dim (text-embedding-3-small shape) so the halfvec(1536) path is exercised; values are a fixed deterministic ramp, not a real embedding (the assertion is about column type + index, not semantic quality).
note: vector is generated deterministically by eval.py from a seed when needed; this header records the shape + provenance so the golden task never reaches for a live embeddings API.
